messages:
Maya Lin: Drafting release note for small docs rollout: batching presets + KV-cache tweaks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5022
Evan Brooks: Can you paste TL;DR bullets? I'll proofread and add SDK snippets.
Maya Lin: TL;DR: 1) New presets: interactive-low-latency, throughput-balanced, cost-saver-1. 2) KV cache: reduced memory use + better prefix reuse. 3) Router favors same-region endpoints to lower p99. Known issue: canary latency underreporting during cache warmup.
Tara Nguyen: Add migration note: custom batching routes should test presets in staging and enable via route config. Also include a brief dedicated pool example.
Evan Brooks: Snippets for Python and JS: 
```
# python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.routes.update('purchase-flow', batching_preset='interactive-low-latency')
```
```
// js
await client.routes.update('purchase-flow', { batchingPreset: 'interactive-low-latency' })
```
Maya Lin: Good. Tara, can you add pool config sample: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-balanced' }` and note to restart long-lived workers?
Tara Nguyen: Added that and a QA checklist: smoke test staging, run p99 ramp, watch canary dashboard for 15m.
release-bot: Please add whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter:
```
---
date: 2025-06-05
title: "Batching presets + KV cache improvements"
components: [runtime, routing]
---
```
QA-bot: Flag: include link to incident tracker for canary issue if observed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2301
Maya Lin: Thanks everyone. Will merge after CI and schedule publish tomorrow 08:30 PST. Will ping eng-oncall at merge for first 30m monitoring.
Evan Brooks: LGTM :shipit:
Tara Nguyen: :white_check_mark:
